newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldovan Apr industrial output fell 13.3 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan Apr industrial output fell 13.3 pct y/y.

text.p: CHISINAU, May 21 - Moldova's industrial output was 13.3 percent below year-ago levels in April and 13.3 percent below the March level, the State Statistics Department said.

Deputy Economy Minister Mikhail Poisic told Reuters firms had curbed output because of new customs duties and value added tax on imported raw materials and equipment and because of new payment regulations on Moldovan goods transitting Ukraine.
Firms owing money for electricity had also cut output, he added.
